jobs.name: Heartbeat Check
jobs.description: Silent every-30-minute health and queue heartbeat.
jobs.message: Read `D:\Doctrine\structure-doctrine-engine\.openclaw\workspaces\aria-ops\HEARTBEAT.md`. Run `python D:\Doctrine\structure-doctrine-engine\health_check.py --json --emit-task` and `python D:\Doctrine\structure-doctrine-engine\scripts\openclaw_task_queue.py report`. health_check.py now includes bar-freshness and engine-cycle checks — if either fails, it is a P0 incident regardless of market hours. Additionally: (1) run `python D:\Doctrine\structure-doctrine-engine\.openclaw\skills\victor-outcome-tracker\outcome_tracker.py` — if PENDING outcomes show bars_tracked=0 after multiple engine cycles on a trading day, create an ops-outcome-tracker incident task. (2) Check the last 5 signals via `python D:\Doctrine\structure-doctrine-engine\.openclaw\skills\db-query\db_query.py latest-signals` — if any LONG signal is SENDABLE but not SENT, flag as a P1 alert-delivery failure. Stay quiet when all checks pass. Surface failures and unusual conditions quickly.
